name: AgrochemicalStoreInventory
tagline: Chemical and fertiliser store app – batches, expiry and FEFO, issues to spray jobs, stock-take and hazard segregation in one PCF control.
description: A complete store management module for farms, spray contractors and ag-retail depots: every product batch by store and bay, goods-in and put-away, issues to spray jobs and returns, transfers, stock-take counts with variance control, configurable hazard-class segregation rules per store or bay, store capacity, quarantine, licensed disposal and supplier returns, reorder suggestions and a dated movement log. Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page.
features: Issue to spray job / return from job
Transfers (single and bulk) with placement checks
Stock-take count sheet with tolerance and reasons
Quarantine, disposal and supplier return with references
MovementJson output for a movement table
Undo, CSV export, keyboard and touch
controlType: standard (two controls: AgrochemicalStoreInventory data-set + AgrochemicalStoreInventoryPortal field control)
